skylite.config.bars.hint: Position and size are edited in game: F8 ("Move the bars") or /skylite edit. LMB — drag, wheel — width of the bar under the cursor, Ctrl+wheel — its thickness, RMB — color.
skylite.config.info.hint: Values the server itself sends: the lines appear above the bars (or in the panel) and are dragged in the editor (F8); FPS/ping — separately, in a corner; Speed — its own plate.
skylite.config.alerts.hint: Words separated by commas. The alert fires when a chat message contains any of them (case does not matter).
skylite.config.chat.rules: Rules (sound, toast, hl, hide — join with +)
skylite.config.chat.rules_ignore: Skip rules if the message has (comma list)
skylite.config.chat.rules.hint: Separate rules with ";". Example: rare drop! => sound+toast

skylite.drops.empty: Empty so far — this session's rare drops will show up here

skylite.editor.title: SkyLite — bar positions
skylite.editor.hint1: LMB — drag · wheel — width · Ctrl+wheel — thickness · RMB — color
skylite.editor.hint3: The Speed plate and each info line are dragged the same way; toggle them in the settings.
skylite.tip.bars.style: The look of all three bars: classic, rounded, capsule, gloss, minimal, framed.
skylite.tip.bars.color_hp: Fill colour of the health (HP) bar.
skylite.tip.bars.color_mana: Fill colour of the mana bar.
skylite.tip.bars.color_xp: Fill colour of the XP bar.
skylite.tip.bars.color_text: Colour of the numbers on the bars.
skylite.tip.bars.width_hp: Width of the HP bar; also adjustable with the mouse wheel in the editor (F8).
skylite.tip.bars.width_mana: Width of the mana bar in pixels.
skylite.tip.bars.width_xp: Width of the XP bar in pixels.
skylite.tip.bars.thickness_hp: Thickness of the HP bar in pixels.
skylite.tip.bars.thickness_mana: Thickness of the mana bar in pixels.
skylite.tip.bars.thickness_xp: Thickness of the XP bar in pixels.
skylite.tip.bars.show_numbers: Draw the current values right on the bars.
skylite.tip.bars.number_background: A dark plate behind the numbers — keeps them readable on any background.
skylite.tip.bars.track_opacity: How visible the bar track is; 0% is fully transparent.
skylite.tip.bars.glyphs: ❤ and ✎ glyphs next to the numbers.
skylite.tip.bars.outline: A thin outline around the bars.
skylite.tip.bars.pulse: The bar pulses when HP or mana is almost gone.
skylite.tip.info.defense: The Defense line from the sidebar.
skylite.tip.info.area: The name of the current area or island.
skylite.tip.info.cookie: Time left on the Cookie Buff.
skylite.tip.info.godpot: Time left on the God Potion.
skylite.tip.info.coords: A line with the current X / Y / Z coordinates.
skylite.tip.info.clock: The current real time "13:20" as a HUD line.
skylite.tip.info.session: How long the game session has been running: the "Session 2h 15m" line.
skylite.tip.info.drops: The "Drops: 3 · 12m" line: how many rare drops the session journal holds and how long ago the newest one landed.
skylite.tip.info.afk: How long you have not moved or pressed any key: the line appears after a minute of idling.
skylite.tip.info.speed: The Speed plate; drag it in the editor (F8).
skylite.tip.info.ping_fps: FPS and real ping counters in a corner of the screen.
skylite.tip.info.ping_graph: A one-minute ping sparkline: green is fast, yellow average, red bad.
skylite.tip.info.lag_badge: A red "LAG" marker in the FPS/ping line once the ping passes the threshold.
skylite.tip.info.lag_threshold: The ping (in milliseconds) at which the LAG badge appears (50–1000).
skylite.tip.info.effects: Active potions with timers: the soonest to expire come first; under 60 s the line is orange, under 15 s red.
skylite.tip.info.effects_max: How many effect lines to show: the rest are hidden, soonest to expire first.
skylite.tip.info.effect_warn: Sound and toast when a potion effect is about to run out — once per effect. The effect list does not need to be on.
skylite.tip.info.effect_warn_sec: How many seconds before the end the effect warning fires (10–60).
skylite.tip.info.lines_max: How many rows the stack above the bars draws (0 = no cap). When the space runs out the top rows disappear first: the ones near the bars win. Moved lines are not counted and always stay visible.
skylite.tip.info.labels: Word labels like "Purse:" and "XYZ:" before the line values. Off — bare numbers only. Every line is dragged separately in the editor (F8).
skylite.tip.info.corner: Which corner shows the FPS and ping.
skylite.tip.alerts.enabled: The master switch for alerts (sound and flash).
skylite.tip.alerts.sound: A sound when an alert fires.
skylite.tip.alerts.chime: Which sound plays on an alert: bell, pling, XP orb or click. Picking one plays it right away.
skylite.tip.alerts.chime_test: Play the selected sound at the current volume.
skylite.tip.alerts.flash: A quick on-screen flash when an alert fires.
skylite.tip.alerts.flash_ms: How many milliseconds the flash stays (0.4–8 s).
skylite.tip.alerts.toast_bg: A dark pill behind toast and flash texts, so they read over bright sky and snow.
skylite.tip.alerts.toast_ms: How many milliseconds a toast stays near the hotbar (0.4–8 s).
skylite.tip.alerts.cooldown: Minimum gap between alerts in milliseconds, so a chat flood does not fill the screen (0 = every match).
skylite.tip.alerts.dedup: The exact same message within 10 seconds fires one alert only.
skylite.tip.alerts.toast: Show the triggering message as a toast above the hotbar — so it is not missed while AFK.
skylite.tip.alerts.toast_max: How many toasts are visible at once: the new one appears at the bottom, older ones rise and fade.
skylite.tip.alerts.keywords: Comma-separated words: the alert fires on a message containing any of them.
skylite.tip.alerts.buff_warn: Sound and toast when the Cookie Buff or God Pot expire within five minutes. One warning per buff until it is refreshed.
skylite.tip.alerts.low_hp: Sound, flash and toast when HP drops below the threshold.
skylite.tip.alerts.low_hp_pct: The HP percentage under which the alert fires.
skylite.tip.alerts.low_mana: Sound, flash and toast when mana drops below the threshold.
skylite.tip.alerts.low_mana_pct: The mana percentage under which the alert fires.
skylite.tip.alerts.inv_warn: A one-time warning when the main inventory (36 slots) is almost out of room. Freeing a couple of slots arms it again.
skylite.tip.alerts.inv_warn_slots: The threshold: the warning fires when this many free slots or fewer remain. 0 — only when the inventory is completely full.
skylite.tip.alerts.kick: A loud bell when you are moved off SkyBlock to Limbo or the lobby (AFK kick, server restart). Connection loss is not watched.
skylite.tip.alerts.presets: Ready-made alerts for typical Hypixel messages: enable the ones you need.
skylite.tip.alerts.preset_party: An alert when a player invites you to a party.
skylite.tip.alerts.preset_trade: An alert when a player wants to trade with you.
skylite.tip.alerts.preset_visit: An alert when someone visits your island.
skylite.tip.alerts.preset_inventory: An alert when the server says your inventory is full.
skylite.tip.alerts.preset_restart: An alert on server restart messages.
skylite.tip.alerts.preset_rare_catch: An alert on "RARE CATCH!" while fishing.
skylite.tip.alerts.drop_shot: Save a screenshot into screenshots/ on every rare drop (RARE DROP! / PET DROP!). Multiple lines of one drop give a single shot. Off by default.
skylite.tip.alerts.drops: The session's rare-drop journal: what, when and where. Also opened by /skylite drops.
skylite.tip.chat.highlight: Highlight chat messages that mention your nickname.
skylite.tip.chat.mention: Sound, flash and toast when chat says your nickname. Your own messages (including the server's echo of them) do not count.
skylite.tip.chat.filter: Hide chat messages containing any of the words below.
skylite.tip.chat.repeats: Hide identical messages that arrive within 10 seconds.
skylite.tip.chat.timestamps: A dark "[HH:MM]" stamp before chat messages. Works for system messages (on Hypixel, all chat); player-chat messages cannot be rewritten without mixins.
skylite.tip.chat.rules_ignore: If a message contains any of these words (comma list), the rules leave it alone: no hiding, no sound, no toast, no marker.
skylite.tip.chat.preset_visits: Adds ready-made island-visit ad rules: "visit my island", "island is open", "/visit" — hide. The rules stay ordinary text, edit the action if you like.
skylite.tip.chat.preset_giveaways: Adds ready-made giveaway rules: "giveaway", "giving away", "drop party" — hide.
skylite.tip.chat.preset_lobby: Adds ready-made lobby-transfer rules: "joined the lobby", "left the lobby", "sending you to" — hide.
skylite.tip.chat.session_coins: A chat line when the purse grows: how many coins were gained this session. Reset: /skylite session reset.
skylite.tip.chat.phrases: Comma-separated words: messages containing them never show up in chat.
skylite.tip.chat.rules: Semicolon-separated "phrase => action" rules. Actions: sound, toast (toast with the text), hl (■ marker on the left), hide (hide the message). Join several with "+": rare drop! => sound+toast.
skylite.tip.hud.hearts: Hide the vanilla hearts — the HP bar replaces them.
skylite.tip.hud.xp_bar: Hide the vanilla XP bar above the hotbar.
skylite.tip.hud.stats_line: Hide Hypixel's stats line at the bottom (the bars already show it).
skylite.tip.hud.in_screens: Keep the bars and info lines on screen while menus are open: the menu's dark backdrop dims them. SkyLite's own screens still hide the HUD.
skylite.tip.opt.profile.balanced: A gentle preset: fewer particles and shadows, almost the same picture.
skylite.tip.opt.profile.performance: Cuts graphics harder: minimal particles, no see-through leaves or biome blend.
skylite.tip.opt.profile.maximum: Everything from Performance plus AO off and distances 8/6.
skylite.tip.opt.restore: Put the game settings back to the state before the first profile was applied.
skylite.tip.opt.mod: Opens the mod's Modrinth page — download the .jar and drop it into the mods folder.
skylite.tip.opt.area.toggle: Apply a profile automatically when the location changes, per the rules below.
skylite.tip.opt.area.default: The profile for locations that match none of the rules.
skylite.tip.opt.bench.title: Measures average FPS and dips over 10 seconds; keep the screen open.
skylite.tip.opt.bench.current: The latest measurement: average FPS and the 1% slowest frames.
skylite.tip.opt.bench.prev: The previous measurement — compare before and after.
skylite.tip.opt.bench.delta: The difference between the two measurements.
